item.title: Show HN: Lots of Agents – Infinite Logged in Grok Bots on One Mac
item.summary: Need more Grok bots in my life but they don't have an account switcher. Build an app cloner for mac so you can have N Grok bots at once. Threw in Cursor etc too since I've used other solutions for ages and was never satisfied with the ergonomics. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49311360 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
